identity.title: Deputy — AI Chief of Staff for Sales & Operations
identity.purpose: Command-center is Gev's operational workspace for Sales & Operations, managed with Deputy — AI Chief of Staff for Sales & Operations.
identity.note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the agent/workspace identity. engine.identity(), hooks, brief, docs and tests read or mirror this block; nothing else may define a different canonical name. Identity does not change authority: the authority ladder in the skill registry is unaffected.

identity_enforcement.note: Any active file declaring another canonical workspace/agent name fails validation. Lines carrying a historical marker are exempt (history must stay readable). Archive/Sources/Journal/audit are history and exempt.

physical_root_note: The canonical workspace name is Command-center. If the host prevented a live rename of the open root directory, the remaining step is a manual folder rename with Claude Code closed; nothing inside the workspace depends on the physical parent path.
authority: This file is the machine-readable structural contract. README.md must agree with it; validate_workspace.py enforces it; workspace_guard.py consumes it.

rules: first alphabetic character uppercase, remaining ordinary letters lowercase
hyphens between words; no spaces; no parentheses; no duplicate suffix like (2)
date only YYYY-MM-DD; version only vN or vN.N; version before date; extension lowercase

reserved_technical_names.note: desktop.ini is a Windows-generated system file; .git/.gitignore/.gitattributes are version-control files.

Tasks.xlsx.purpose: The single live task register (hand-edited by the Head; read by skills).

Journal.md.purpose: Daily log, newest day on top.

README.md.purpose: Human-readable guide; must agree with this policy.

00_Inbox/Input.md.purpose: Controlled manual text drop; processed content is cleared.

00_Inbox.purpose: Temporary unclassified input only; steady state empty except Input.md.
allowed_content: any file dropped by the Head, pending classification
00_Inbox.retention_rule: must be emptied at every session start; only Input.md persists
invariants: non-Input files are violations older than one session

01_Active.purpose: Work currently being developed, reviewed, investigated or executed.
01_Active.retention_rule: move to 02_Reference when approved and authoritative; to 03_Completed when finished; to 05_Archive when superseded

02_Reference.purpose: Approved CURRENT source-of-truth artifacts still used to operate the business.
02_Reference.retention_rule: superseded version → 05_Archive the day the replacement is approved

03_Completed.purpose: Finished deliverables no longer active and not the current operational source of truth.

04_Sources.purpose: Raw evidence and original external inputs only.
allowed_content: original exports, chats, media, screenshots, raw imports

source_naming.file_rule: original export names are kept when they already satisfy the technical filename regex; otherwise renamed to business form

05_Archive.purpose: Superseded documents, obsolete drafts and old implementation artifacts retained for history. Not current truth.

.claude.purpose: Deputy runtime: settings, hooks, docs, policy, skills, tools, tests, state, audit, runtime, business (operating model), integrations (read-only live-data layer).

.claude/hooks.purpose: Lifecycle and enforcement hooks (brief, skill gate, workspace guard).

.claude/docs.purpose: Durable agent documentation (role, job description, audits).

.claude/tools.purpose: Operational helper programs that are tools rather than skills.

.claude/runtime.purpose: Deterministic project interpreter: .venv bootstrap + hook launcher (python_runtime.py, hook.sh) and the pinned dependency manifest (requirements.txt) with its lock (requirements.lock). Every hook, CLI, test, eval and release runs under <root>/.venv, never the PATH python.

.claude/business.purpose: Business Operating Model in two layers. CORE (INTERNAL, versionable): authoring bm_*.py, schema, builder, certifier — roles without compensation, processes, ownership by ROLE, KPIs, controlled targets, playbooks, routines, gaps, source metadata; people only as @P tokens. SENSITIVE OVERLAY (CONFIDENTIAL, local only): overlay/ov_*.py → overlay.json (person names, role assignments, compensation, commercial figures, evidence payloads). Generated *.json, Business-model.md and certification.json are local; the boundary is enforced by data_classification.json + sensitive_scan.py (pre-commit/pre-push).

.claude/business/overlay.purpose: CONFIDENTIAL local layer: ov_people.py (person tokens → names, role assignments), ov_compensation.py, ov_commercials.py, ov_evidence.py. Never versioned; scanner blocks it mechanically.

.claude/state.purpose: Runtime state only (SQLite store, journal, quarantine, migrated legacy).
.claude/state.note_durability: runtime store (SQLite + journal + locks + integration cache/health) is MACHINE-LOCAL/EPHEMERAL; the canonical DURABLE export lives in .claude/state/durable (commitments, decisions, audit, observations) and is versioned; bootstrap imports it idempotently

.claude/integrations.purpose: READ-ONLY live business information layer: registry (declared integrations, fact authority), contracts (normalized envelopes), adapters (fixed read operations per system), health, reconciliation, certification. No write capability exists here by design.
.claude/integrations.allowed_files_note: python modules + the fixed read-only PowerShell reader for Outlook (outlook_read.ps1, integrity-pinned) + generated certification.json (local, INTERNAL, never versioned)
invariants: no adapter exposes a write/send/update/delete operation
secrets are read from the environment or ~/.command-center/integrations, never from the repository

.secure.purpose: Encrypted recovery artifacts (active external-system credentials) + plaintext manifest without secret values. Decryptable only with the ONE external recovery key (~/.command-center/recovery.key), which never enters Git.
invariants: credentials.gpg is GnuPG symmetric AES-256 (no custom crypto)

.claude/state/durable.purpose: Deterministic canonical export of Deputy's durable operating memory (state_snapshot.py export/import).

source_markers.note: raw evidence classified by name/kind may only live in 04_Sources (or 05_Archive)

semantics.reference_vs_completed: 02_Reference holds artifacts that are still authoritative; 03_Completed holds finished deliverables that are no longer truth. Mechanically checkable part: names signalling draft/copy are forbidden in both; the same base document may not exist in both.

links.note: relative links must resolve; anchors and URLs are ignored

temporary_staging.purpose: one-off consolidation of scattered work material from this PC before Mission 4.1; staging only — not part of the taxonomy, never committed, removed after Gev's review
rules: contents are not validated against naming rules (ignored subtree)

durability.law: No important local-only durable truth. Everything Deputy or Gev needs tomorrow is (1) versioned directly, (2) versioned as an encrypted recovery artifact, or (3) deterministically reproducible from versioned content. Only ephemeral or machine-specific data stays local.
durability.tree_manifest: .claude/policy/workspace_tree_manifest.json (generated from this policy by tree_manifest.py; validator checks both)
durability.checksums: .claude/policy/durable_checksums.json (sha256 of durable files; refreshed by release/bootstrap)

recovery_key.rule: the ONE intentionally external secret: never in Git, never printed, never in audit/state; Gev keeps a copy in a password manager or on an external device

VERSION_DIRECTLY: .claude/docs, hooks, policy, runtime, skills, tools, tests, integrations (code)
REGENERATE: .claude/skills/registry.json is versioned but rebuilt by release
EPHEMERAL: .claude/state/skill_state.db (+wal/shm), journal.jsonl, tickets, integrations_cache/health json, *.lock, .claude/audit/skill_audit.jsonl mirror (the store export is the durable form)

live_data.rule: LIVE OPERATIONAL DATA (the task register, the journal, the inbox text) and Deputy's durable runtime state change every day. They are versioned directly (durability law) but they are NOT product/model inputs: a change requires only the lightweight LIVE DATA SYNC (skill.py sync) — never a business-model rebuild, a certification or a release. Everything else that is versioned is PRODUCT (code, policy, hooks, skills, tests, business-model authoring bm_*.py/overlay, extraction sources) and changes only through skill.py release.
live_data.business_documents: 00_Inbox … 05_Archive documents that are not declared business-model extraction sources are DOCUMENT data (sync); a declared CONTENT-scoped source (bm_sources.py) is a MODEL_SOURCE (release)
live_data.sync: python .claude/skills/skill.py sync [--dry-run] [--no-push]  (classify drift → export durable state → static model still certified? → refresh checksums → commit only the classified paths → push → verify origin)

drift_states.CLEAN: nothing to persist, GitHub main is current
drift_states.SYNC_REQUIRED: live data / durable state / integrity metadata changed or commits not pushed — run skill.py sync
drift_states.RELEASE_REQUIRED: product, model-authoring or extraction-source change — run skill.py release
drift_states.UNCLASSIFIED: unknown path changed — fail closed, nothing is synced
